svg.title: Tangent alignment model: constrained ELR schedules

cc:Work.dc:title: Tangent alignment model: constrained ELR schedules
cc:Work.dc:description: Conditional scalar alignment model, not actual MuonH training. Constant target drift, tangent unit updates, a prescribed 160-update warmup, and an artificial tail maximum decrement of 0.00006. All curves share the same peak and zero final applied rate. The inverse-square-root plus terminal-cap curve is the model optimum under those assumptions; comparisons use linear, cosine, and affine inverse-square-root (AIR) tails. All axes are linear.
